countBasis: Each listed item tests a distinct diagnostic or treatment decision. Count follows chapter breadth and clinical importance, not an official NEET-SS weighting or a fixed 30/40 target.
coverageRevision: Added two distinct high-yield mould decisions after review: CNS aspergillosis and rhino-orbito-cerebral mucormycosis. This closes a fungal coverage gap rather than adding repeated cryptococcal questions.

crossChapterBoundaries: Emphasize CNS syndrome interpretation, localization, CSF, imaging and neurological treatment sequencing here. General antimicrobial pharmacology, systemic infection work-up and vaccination schedules belong to the later Infectious disease chapters without repeating these exact decisions.
